notes.title: Moonlight Peaks to be published by XSEED/Marvelous
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/a76b2119b60ef426776319acfa95983bc49f645c.png[/img]

[b]XSEED Games[/b], the independent-minded publishing brand of [b]Marvelous USA, Inc.[/b], today announced an agreement with Dutch developers Little Chicken to publish their in-development supernatural life sim title [b]Moonlight Peaks[/b] in North America in 2026. Sister company Marvelous Europe jointly announced that they will publish the title in Europe, targeting a simultaneous release. [b]Moonlight Peaks[/b] will join the growing library of third-party indie titles published by XSEED Games, complementing their internally developed catalog of titles by [b]Marvelous Inc.[/b]

“[i]We always look for projects that offer our audience diverse new titles with our indie publishing efforts, but this time we’ve found a project that’s much closer to home,[/i]” said Kenji Hosoi, Executive Vice President of XSEED Games.[i]“[b]Moonlight Peaks[/b] is a supernatural fit given our deep experience with the farming/life sim genre, and we look forward to working with the team at Little Chicken to bring their game to life, and our fans![/i]”

[b]Moonlight Peaks[/b] takes place in its titular town, home to vampires, werewolves, mermaids, and other supernatural denizens who mostly come out at night—where the unnatural is the norm. As the grown-up progeny of Count Dracula, players will have to prove to their skeptical father that an (un-)life of compassion is possible, even for the undead. While players design their perfect vampire lair and learn the art of farming magical crops and witchcraft, they’ll get to know the eclectic mix of human and supernatural residents that also call [b]Moonlight Peaks[/b] home, and maybe even find their eternal love! More information about the setting and features of Moonlight Peaks will be revealed at a later date, but players can download a new demo on PC right now for a glimpse at the haunted haven that awaits.

“[i]Partnering with Marvelous and their group of companies for a worldwide release was an opportunity we were excited to accept,[/i]” said Yannis Bolman, President of Little Chicken Game Company. “[i]As pioneers in the farming and life-sim genre with Story of Seasons and then the Rune Factory series, we were thrilled to be invited into their family. [b]Moonlight Peaks[/b] will fit seamlessly into their publishing portfolio, and we hope to introduce fans of those series to our own innovative and unique ideas for the genre.[/i]”

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Live the vampire life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks
[*] Master the art of potions and spells
[*] Manage your supernatural farm
[*] Make friends with the local werewolves, witches, and mermaids, and find your eternal love in the supernatural dating scene
[*] More to come!
[/list]
Developed by Little Chicken and published in the Americas by XSEED Games, [b]Moonlight Peaks[/b] is currently in development for Windows PC via Steam. The game will be published in Europe by Marvelous Europe. This title has not yet been rated by the ESRB.

notes.title: New Farming Demo!
notes.content:
We're excited to share the latest update for [b]Moonlight Peaks[/b], just in time for the [b]Steam Farming Fest[/b]! We have been hard at work to bring you the Farming Fest Demo, packed with new features and improvements! 💜

[list]
[*] Complete the farming questline!
[*] Meet Fiona, a new character joining the Moonlight Peaks community
[*] Dive into the lore of Moonlight Peaks with five new Chronicles
[*] We've added two special flowers, along with eleven new crops and herbs to diversify your harvest
[*] Spells now require mana to cast, adding a strategic element to your magic use
[*] Eating produce and fish will now replenish your mana reserves
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/955e0b8f37ef23fb3c8ee0d61b07305b822e90ac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/ba079c878a227ab59520d3ec4d5b5240a2683a46.png[/img]

Quality of life updates include a revamped spell casting screen, updated crop icons, smoother animations, and improved tool handling. We've also fixed grammar issues and addressed bugs to ensure a smoother farming experience!

As always, we value your input, which is why we've included a survey option in the main menu. Your feedback helps us continue to refine and improve the Moonlight Peaks experience for everyone.

For the full changelog, [url=https://discord.com/invite/heWNF8A8Aw]join our Discord[/url], and don't forget to share your farm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/35ae4cee40d452b06fc1c8d4c9f932d605421780.png[/img]

notes.title: Winter Demo!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Moonlighters![/h1]

We’re thrilled to announce the upcoming release of our Winter Demo! The demo will be released on Steam the 23rd of December, and comes with extended gameplay, allowing you to immerse yourself in the magical world of Moonlight Peaks for a full 30 days! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/e80631a453a56a3c939ff6a9ab7d55711a468c48.png[/img]
[h3]What to Expect in the Winter Demo:[/h3]

❄️ [b]New Winter Decorations:[/b] Transform your farm into a snowy spectacle with holiday-themed décor!

❄️ [b]Updated Character:[/b] Version 3 of our character is here! See the new chibi style on the main character and the mayor!

❄️ [b]Longer Days:[/b] Enjoy more time to craft and create with the extension of each day!

❄️ [b]Option to Play for 30 Days:[/b] Dive deeper into the life-sim experience with an extended playtime!

❄️[b] Sitting on Furniture:[/b] Every chair and stool can be enjoyed by you, and your Hellkitten companion!

❄️ [b]Planting Trees:[/b] You can now plant all trees, and also mirror them!

❄️[b] Improvements to Keyboard Controls and Option to Rebind Keys:[/b] Tweak the keyboard controls to your preferred layout!

And a bunch of other tweaks and improvements. You can find the full changelog on [url=https://discord.com/invite/heWNF8A8Aw]our Discord![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/727b51c03f16a58f5db9dc0468ea194170ce8d72.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/b6261c97d45d5fdb888bb73c0fd54387ca38b8d3.png[/img]
Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to share this magical journey with you!

Happy decorating and joyful holidays,
The Little Chicken Team 💜❄️⛄️

notes.title: Dev Log: First Demo!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Decorating Demo
[/b][/h2]

Exciting news from the heart of our development! We're delighted to share that we've been hard at work on our very first demo, and we can't wait to offer you a glimpse into Moonlight Peaks soon! 

This early sneak peek is exclusive to Steam and will be available for a limited time starting [b]October 26th! [/b]In this upcoming demo, we're diving into the decorating aspect of Moonlight Peaks. You'll get an early peek at some of the farm customization options that will be available in the full game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/27b2af2ea4b3e490b563da1eb92640380bd5c5a0.gif[/img]

While our main focus remains on decoration, the demo will also introduce you to a few other game features like potions, spells, farming, crafting, and shapeshifting! The demo takes place over 7 in-game nights, but you can play it as many times as you like. We’ve included a variety of surprises to keep you coming back. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/2d09e505990c2f9c05975ba69f45cfe6cb8ef473.png[/img]
[i]At the end of the demo, you'll get the option to download a picture of your farm, to share with the community![/i]

Please note that some full game features, such as exploring the town, NPC interaction, dating, and character customization, will not be included in this demo. Rest assured, we're still working hard on those aspects, and we'll share them with you as soon as they are ready. While the demo focuses on the core gameplay elements, we have exciting plans on the horizon.

We've put our hearts and souls into creating this demo, and we're eager to have you explore it. Your feedback is incredibly important to us, and we're looking forward to hearing your thoughts on the demo. After completing the demo, we offer a survey for those interested in providing extended feedback!

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being a part of our community!

The Little Chicken Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/3482afb30f8dc4e25ca21acb1a539058cc348523.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Log: Decorating 🦇
notes.content:
In Moonlight Peaks, we want to put a strong emphasis on personalization and creativity. In this log, we’ll take a look at the various aspects of the decorating system, showcasing how players will be able to make their farming plot and home their own. 

[b]Customising the Interior
[/b]Our goal is to offer an extensive selection of furniture sets and styles, ensuring there's something to suit every taste. We're making sure there are dark and light options, as well as some interesting options in between! We're currently also working on a feature that allows players to stack objects, granting even greater flexibility in interior design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/03a750347ecc9dc52a0a05818049e215097b1828.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/1785bfeaa7d61772f8a9d4e76380a8c770ce26b6.png[/img]
[b]Different House Styles
[/b]You'll have the freedom to handpick from a variety of roof styles, colors and window designs! We’re also adding different architectural styles for houses. From Gothic-inspired grandeur to rustic charm and cozy wooden cabins, we want players to have the power to harmonize their homes with their farm's theme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/27b2af2ea4b3e490b563da1eb92640380bd5c5a0.gif[/img]

[b]Expanding Interior Spaces
[/b]We want to give players the option to expand their home by unlocking additional rooms. These expansions can be obtained at the local Carpenter Shop in Moonlight Peaks, in exchange for a combination of resources and in-game currency. The local carpenter, brother of the Mayor, Ridge, will be taking care of all your additions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/8007a47c13f1a2776c71eea8f3410e1e68debf0c.png[/img]
[b]Farm Buildings
[/b]Beyond house expansions, we're also brainstorming a variety of farm buildings, including barns, silos, wells, mills, and more. These structures not only serve practical functions like crop storage and flour milling but also add to the overall charm of your farm. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/d07ff7b7cb5259349b1adf9d9ac23699a6b58802.png[/img]
[b]Unlocking Decorations
[/b]As the game progresses, players will be able to reach different milestones and complete quests. These achievements will not only progress the narrative, but also unlock new decorative items for their farm and home. 
[list]
[*] [b]Quest Rewards:[/b]  Completing story-driven quests will yield unique and thematic decorations, such as rare flowers, enchanted crystals, and mystical artefacts. 
[*] [b]Milestone Achievements: [/b] Reaching certain milestones, like harvesting a specific number of crops or nurturing animals, will grant players access to decorations that reflect their accomplishments. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43515196/59a332fda2d9e73c44922039490adc2c3f6d6cbe.png[/img]

We can't wait to see how you'll shape your farm and home in this enchanting world, and we're looking forward to share more on the development of Moonlight Peaks!
The Little Chicken Team
